children: NVIDIA (NVDA) named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO as its board searches for a permanent leader. Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian was reported to be among those considered.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang and company officials agreed to testify before three House committees probing access to confidential data and alleged chip diversions to China. No hearing date has been set.
NVIDIA’s Singapore sales drew scrutiny after Bessent cited estimates that just 1% of chips sold there stayed in the country. Singapore made up over 20% of NVIDIA’s global sales in 2024.
Morgan Stanley cut NVIDIA’s price target to $267 from $300, maintaining an Overweight rating amid reported CEO Jensen Huang departure, succession uncertainty and China regulatory risks.
Chinese filings reportedly show Dell servers with banned NVIDIA H800 chips and Super Micro systems with H100 or H200 chips at a Shanghai data center. NVIDIA declined to comment.
NVIDIA was downgraded by Truist, Melius Research, Oppenheimer and Bernstein. Barclays kept an Overweight rating but cut its price target to $210; HSBC lowered its rating to Hold, with a $170 target.
- NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) is scheduled to report its results this week, in an event described as a test for the AI-driven tech rally.
A report said Chinese companies are accessing NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) AI chips through data centers in Southeast Asia, exploiting a gap in U.S. sanctions.
An open letter urging NVIDIA’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang pending an independent probe drew over 157,000 signatures, including more than 7,500 from people who say they work at the company.
• Two major shareholders of NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA), Brad Gerstner and Gavin Baker, urged the company’s board to keep all options open regarding its leadership.
